description: An action pinned by digest under a floating major tag such as # v4 is moved to an exact release such as # v4.3.1, never kept on the floating tag. A floating tag moves upstream while the pinned digest stays, so its comment goes stale until the next digest update, which jactionlint reports as a version comment that no longer matches the pin. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver in the default preset is what keeps every comment naming the exact release of its digest.
